# SMI Ergodic Oscillator

*SMI Ergodic minus its signal, as a histogram.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **SMI Ergodic Oscillator** under **Oscillators**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Long length | int | `20` |
| Short length | int | `5` |
| Signal line length | int | `5` |
| Above zero | color | `"#26A69A"` |
| Below zero | color | `"#FF5252"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/smio.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "SMI Ergodic Oscillator", shortTitle: "SMIO", overlay: false, precision: 4 });
const longLength = input.int("Long length", 20, { min: 1 }), shortLength = input.int("Short length", 5, { min: 1 }), signalLength = input.int("Signal line length", 5, { min: 1 });
const erg = ta.tsi(candle.close, shortLength, longLength);
plot(ta.calc([erg, ta.ema(erg, signalLength)], (e, s) => e - s), { title: "SMI Ergodic Oscillator", style: "columns",
  colorUp: input.color("Above zero", "#26A69A", { group: "Style" }), colorDown: input.color("Below zero", "#FF5252", { group: "Style" }) });
```
